# Decision: Descriptive title

Template: create this record in the pending decision folder under an existing or
new task. Choose a unique, stable descriptive basename. Remove this paragraph and
unused optional sections; resolve links from the destination folder. Folder
location determines pending, accepted, or archived disposition; add no status field.

## Problem and context

Explain the choice, constraints, and why it needs a user decision. Reference the
owning task, affected tasks, and related decisions with stable basenames and links.

## Options and tradeoffs

- Option A: practical consequences, benefits, and drawbacks.
- Option B: practical consequences, benefits, and drawbacks.

## Recommendation

State the agent's recommendation and rationale. This is a proposal, not approval.

## User choice and approval evidence

Pending user choice. After actual approval, record the chosen option, relevant
conditions, and the approval's date/context or available reference. Existing user
instructions count; do not ask again or invent an approval or message identifier.
Do not paste a conversation transcript.

## Consequences and implementation references

After approval, record accepted consequences and link implementation tasks. Keep
implementation progress in tasks and current behavior in architecture documents.

## Archive disposition

Use only when archived: rejected, withdrawn, or superseded; explain why, whose
choice it was, and link the replacement when applicable. A substantive revision
requires a new user-approved record rather than rewriting the original choice.
